subject: Medivex evidence runbook & PO routing prerequisites
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medivex.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Higgins <thiggins@medivex.com>, procure@medivex.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial evidence runbook & PO path for Redwood engagement

Hi Irene / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. As we start the commercial review with our legal and procurement teams, they asked that we collect a short "evidence runbook" that lists the documents and routing steps required to get a PO in place and to clear the security gate before contract signature.

High level asks from our side: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and the date range covered
- ISO 27001 certificate or attestation (if applicable)
- Recent penetration test letter or executive summary (redacted ok)
- Data flow diagram and brief description of where customer data is processed (one page)
- Standard vendor forms: W-9 / tax info, supplier onboarding form (we attached ours)
- PO routing: invoice remit address, vendor legal name + tax id, preferred PO contact

Can you confirm which of the above you can provide directly, and whether any items require additional paperwork (NDA, DPA, addendum)? Also please confirm expected turnaround (we're hoping to package the evidence by end of next week so our procurement can open the PO).

I attached our onboarding form to make sure you hit our required fields. If helpful, we can accept redacted SOC 2 and pen test letters initially and request originals during contract execution.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Soto
Senior Procurement Manager
Medivex Health
(415) 555-0198
(Attachment: Medivex_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf))

Elena — thanks for the note and the form.

Kimberly, looping you and Marissa in — we'll own the evidence bundle and PO routing details for Medivex. Quick plan:

1) I'll gather the governance documents (SOC 2 Type II, ISO attestation) and confirm dates.
2) Kimberly will validate the pen test attestation scope and provide a redacted letter.
3) Marissa will map the PO remit info and share the invoice routing guidance + vendor legal name and tax ID.

Target: deliver a consolidated evidence zip + manifest by EOD Friday 2027-05-28 so procurement can open the PO the week after. If you need anything sooner, call my cell.

Thanks Elena — quick clarifying question on the pen test item.

- Do you need a full penetration test report or will a vendor-issued pen test attestation letter plus executive summary suffice for your security team initially? We typically provide a redacted exec summary and an attestation letter that confirms an independent test was performed and the date. Full reports are available under NDA.

Also: is Medivex okay with receiving SOC 2 Type II as a redacted PDF (we redact client names in the report)? If your legal needs unredacted copies, we can set an access path (e.g., secure transfer or NDA).

Timeline note: we're on track to assemble the runbook by Friday; Marissa will circulate the manifest and the drive link.

Kimberly Park
Vendor Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
